title: Feature Request: /credit to show remaining credits in our account
body: would be handy to have a /credit to check how much money we can still burn.
author: asfarsadewa

top_comments.author: bherrmann7
top_comments.body: good lord, how can this thing not show you how many credits you have left?    I guess it can be murky if you have a backend router which connects to different providers.   But for the normal case where you are burning credits (or weekly or daily hours) - the tool which is burning those resources should be able to tell you where you stand.
